## GOAL ALIGNMENT
Part I:  Individual Motivations, Strengths & Development Goals
WHO ARE WE AS A TEAM? Team exercise:  Discuss each member’s prior work experience, professional goals, and the core areas where you each hope to evolve as a leader.
Part II:  Team Goals
HOW DO WE KNOW IF WE ARE SUCCESSFUL?  Team exercise:  Based on your individual motivations, work together to develop your team’s goals while ensuring they align with your individual aims. Does each team member fully understand them and believe in them?  Are team members energized by them?  How will the team know if you’ve achieved these goals?  What impact will your team have if you achieve success?  What milestones need to be hit at what times to get there?
NOTE: Team goals should be challenging, consequential, and measurable.
